verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only Carta's developer/API documentation (cap table read endpoints, OAuth, MCP plugin setup) and unrelated community complaints about sales practices and cancellation — none of it describes an actual priced-round scenario modeling tool (dilution modeling, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership) or a workflow for sharing such a scenario with counsel and investors. missing for 10: any documentation of a scenario/round-modeling UI or workflow, evidence of SAFE conversion modeling, option pool top-up modeling, or a share-with-counsel/investors feature.
